title: Armory: Important Systems
summary: Read the Armory signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Energy capacity, instability, installed modules, and cosmetic trim can all live on the item stack. Read the tooltip before assuming a tool is ready.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch durability, module roles, tier expectations, repair cost, ammo or charge pressure, and whether each slot helps the route you are actually taking.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Armory system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: System Anchor
blocks.body: Use this reference to turn the system note into a concrete field check.
